name: audio-upload
description: Uploaded-audio job: a synthetic PCM WAV attached to a native multipart POST /v1/jobs, dispatched to a provider adapter that accepts audio attachments. Measures accept latency, artifact integrity (size and sha256 as stored) and job completion. The audio is a deterministic tone, not speech, so completion is checked structurally, never for transcript content.
prompt: Transcribe the attached audio verbatim. Return plain text only, no commentary.
